notes: Labels use the STM32 'Micro' column name (PB6, DSI_D1_N...) where printed; Arduino names (D76, A0, ~D13) and peripheral names follow in functions, read outward. IN/OUT power badges, D default icons, column headers and color tags omitted. RESET overlined Micro name in image 1/4 is an exact repeat and omitted. J6 rows 9 and 10 are both bracketed to D66 (left) and D67 (right) ('Pins D66 and D67 are duplicated pins'). Long notes not recorded as functions: OFF pad 'Short this with GND to turn off the entire board', VRTC coin-cell note, 'Pins A8, A9, A10 and A11 are ONLY analog pins, no GPIO peripherals', 'DSI PINS have only display feature, NO GPIO, NO Analog', 'J6 is compatible with Arducam', image 6 'Configured to be used with LTDC Display at 24bit'. Skipped: BOOT0 and reset buttons, RGB LED, unlabeled on-board headers in image 1, D1 diode/U9 switch callouts, image 8 (internal SDRAM/FMC, wireless module, crypto and QSPI flash; no external pin positions). J5 in image 7 has no pin-1 mark, so the edge rule gives the right column first there, while images 2/3 mark pin 1 on the left (D1N) column.
